# The files whose change can change the pictures of scripts/screenshots.sh: after a
# change of main that touches one, the screenshot bot renders them anew. One pattern
# on each line, as the paths of a workflow: * within a folder, ** through folders, and
# one that starts with ! leaves files out. The script and this list count on their
# own. The blueprint brought it once; it belongs to this project.
#
# The texts of the assistant and the pages of the pictures are not listed:
# test_the_pictures_show_what_the_assistant_posts makes the pull request that changes
# them render the pictures anew. Listed are the tools, which no test sees.
.github/social-preview.html
.github/social-preview/Dockerfile
scripts/social-preview.sh
scripts/render-images.sh
requirements-images.txt
